director.text: Namaste Riya, main Asha, tumhari AI teacher hoon. Aaj cricket pitch jaise number line par fractions dekhenge. Tumhe cricket mein kya pasand hai?
Riya, pitch par stumps se boundary tak ka raasta socho; use chaar barabar hisson mein baanto. Tumhare hisaab se pehla hissa kya dikhayega?
Haan Riya, lesson thodi der ruk sakta hai. Kis baare mein baat karna chahti ho? Phir fractions par lautenge.
Chalo Riya, cricket pitch ko 5 barabar gaps mein baanto; 0 se pehla gap kis fraction ko dikhayega?
Riya, 0 se 1 tak 5 equal gaps honge; 2/5 ke liye 0 se 2 gaps aage mark karenge. Agla step dikhaun?
Riya, game: 0 se 2 jumps ke baad tum number line par kis point par land karogi?
Riya, tumne “3” bola—shayad 3rd mark keh rahi ho? Yahan 2 jumps ka point 2/5 hai; game mein phir se 2 jumps try karo.
Riya, ye part boring lag raha hai—chalo tareeka badalte hain: picture, story, ya game mein se kya choose karogi?
Riya, kaunsa choose karogi: Picture dikhao, Kahani mein batao, ya Game khelte hain?
Riya, kahani: 0 se 1 tak paanch barabar kadam hain. 2/5 wala dost beech se pehle khada hai ya baad?
director.card: Khaali jagah bharo: Check: 2/5 is ___ the middle, because 2/5 is less than 1/2.

director.text: Riya, rukna hai toh teen choices hain: continue karein, chhota break lein, ya aaj ke liye stop karein. Tum kya choose karogi?
